translations.b0132: Part 5  Building a Strong Domestic Market and Accelerating the Creation of a New Development Paradigm
translations.b0133: China will uphold expanding domestic demand as the strategic focus, closely integrate efforts to improve people’s wellbeing with efforts to boost consumption, and combine investment in physical assets with investment in people, let new demand guide new supply and new supply create new demand, promote sound interaction between consumption and investment and between supply and demand, achieve a dynamic balance between supply and demand at a higher level, and enhance the internal driving forces and reliability of domestic circulation.
translations.b0135: The special initiative to boost consumption will be carried out in depth; residents’ consumption capacity will be strengthened and their willingness to consume improved; high-quality supply will be expanded to meet the consumption needs of different groups; and relatively rapid growth will be promoted in the consumption of goods and services across society.
translations.b0136: Section 1  Consolidating the Foundation for Household Consumption
translations.b0137: A coordinated approach will be taken to promoting employment, increasing incomes and stabilizing expectations, and a long-term mechanism for expanding household consumption will be formed at a faster pace. Employment capacity will be stabilized and expanded; enterprises will be supported in keeping existing jobs and creating new ones; individuals will be supported in starting businesses and finding jobs; new professions and new jobs will be actively cultivated; and new employment space will be opened up in the digital economy, the green economy, the silver economy and other areas. Vigorous efforts will be made to increase the incomes of urban and rural residents; minimum wage standards will be raised steadily; the operating environment for small and micro businesses and self-employed individuals will be continuously improved; and the sound development of the housing and stock markets will be promoted. The social security safety net will be made more dense and robust; flexible workers and people in new forms of employment will be encouraged and supported to participate in employee insurance; the dynamic adjustment mechanism for subsistence allowance standards linked to per capita consumption expenditure will be improved and standardized; and more government funds will be allocated to spending that safeguards people’s wellbeing.
translations.b0138: Section 2  Unlocking the Potential of Service Consumption
translations.b0139: Service consumption will be expanded with a focus on relaxing market access and integrating business formats, and new growth points in service consumption will be cultivated. The convenience of everyday service consumption will be improved; community-embedded services and 15-minute convenient living circles will be developed; traditional commercial districts will be renewed; and the service consumption experience in areas such as elderly care, childcare and household services will be improved. The share of development-oriented consumption will be raised; diversified and personalized service needs will be met; education and training consumption will be developed in a well-regulated manner; health consumption will be cultivated and expanded; and high-quality international service resources will be actively introduced. The vitality of upgrading consumption will be stimulated; consumption on culture, sports and tourism will be expanded; the approval and management of commercial performances and sports events will be optimized; the plan to upgrade ice and snow tourism will be implemented; leisure consumption such as cruise ships, yachts and recreational vehicle camping will be developed; and low-altitude consumption will be actively expanded. The integration of commerce, tourism, culture, sports and health will be deepened, and a number of immersive and interactive new consumption scenarios will be created.
translations.b0140: Section 3  Expanding and Upgrading the Consumption of Goods
translations.b0141: Brand leadership, standards upgrading and the application of new technologies will be strengthened; big-ticket consumption will be stabilized; consumer goods will be upgraded; and consumer demand at multiple levels will be met. Real estate policies will be optimized according to the conditions of each city, expectations will be stabilized through a combination of measures, the potential of essential and upgrading housing demand will be fully unleashed, and age-friendly renovation and intelligent upgrading of old housing will be supported. The shift of automobile consumption from purchase management to use management will be deepened; infrastructure such as battery charging and swapping facilities and parking lots will be improved; and aftermarket consumption such as automobile modification and leasing will be expanded. The development of recycling systems for automobiles, electronic products, home appliances and furniture will be supported, and the circulation order of second-hand goods will be regulated. A digital consumption upgrading initiative will be implemented; the application of new smart products will be promoted; standards for smart home interoperability will be formulated; and flexible and customized production models for consumer goods will be promoted. Green consumption will be developed, and green and low-carbon products will be actively promoted. New growth points in mid- and high-end consumption will be cultivated; time-honored brands and trendy domestic brands will be made more refined and stronger; consumption of derivative merchandise will be developed; and the first-launch economy will be actively advanced.
translations.b0142: Section 4  Continuing to Improve the Consumption Environment
translations.b0143: Institutional mechanisms for promoting consumption will be improved; unreasonable restrictive measures in the consumption field will be sorted out; and management mechanisms suited to new consumption formats, models and scenarios will be established and improved. Inclusive policies that directly benefit consumers will be strengthened; the supply of financial services for consumption will be expanded; and a number of new consumption scenarios with broad spillover effects and high visibility will be created. The inbound consumption environment will be improved; departure tax refund stores will be promoted; international consumption center cities will be cultivated; and the “Shopping in China” campaign will be advanced. The system of paid annual leave for employees will be implemented; flexible staggered leave will be encouraged; and the introduction of spring and autumn holidays for primary and secondary school students will be explored. Consumer rights and interests will be better protected; channels for consumer complaints and rights protection will be kept open; business activities such as online sales and livestream marketing will be regulated; and the regulatory model for prepaid consumption will be improved. Full-caliber consumption statistics will be strengthened, and statistical monitoring of service consumption and new consumption formats and models will be improved.
translations.b0145: China will accelerate the establishment of an endogenous growth mechanism for effective investment, maintain reasonable investment growth, improve the overall returns on investment, and better leverage the role of investment in supporting national strategies, optimizing the supply structure and meeting people’s needs.
translations.b0146: Section 1  Improving the Returns on Government Investment
translations.b0147: Government investment will be structured to focus on improving people’s wellbeing, shoring up weak links and building new growth drivers. “Hard investment” and “soft development” will be coordinated; the implementation of major national strategies and the building of projects to strengthen security capacity in key areas will be advanced to high standards; and a number of major landmark projects will be launched. Investment in human resource development and people’s all-round development will be stepped up; a number of wellbeing projects will be implemented in areas such as services for the elderly and children, primary-level medical and health care, the expansion of general senior secondary education and high-quality higher education, and vocational skills training; and the share of government investment in people’s wellbeing will be raised. In response to changes in the population structure and migration trends, the layout of infrastructure and public service facilities will be improved. In keeping with the requirements for developing new quality productive forces, investment in new infrastructure and intangible assets will be actively supported. Government investment will be managed throughout the whole process; the guiding role of strategic planning, project planning, reserve and feasibility assessment, and ongoing and ex post oversight will be strengthened; and excessive, premature construction and low-efficiency or ineffective investment will be avoided. The direction and priorities of central and local investment will be further clarified; all types of government investment will be used in a coordinated way; and localities with a solid foundation of work will explore the formulation of full-caliber government investment plans. The management of local government special bonds will be improved; the “self-review and self-issuance” mechanism will be refined; the proportion of such bonds used for project construction will be increased and specified separately; and the role of new types of policy-based financial instruments will be brought into play. Reform of the investment approval system will be deepened; the approval authority for government investment projects will be optimized; the catalogue of investment projects subject to government approval will be revised; and the efficiency of investment approval services will be improved.
translations.b0148: Section 2  Stimulating the Vitality of Private Investment
translations.b0149: Equal treatment, protection of rights and interests, and policy coordination will be upheld; the growth drivers of market-led effective investment will be strengthened; and the share of private investment will be increased. The long-term mechanism for private enterprises to participate in the construction of major projects will be improved; private enterprises will be encouraged and supported to participate in the construction of projects in fields such as railways, nuclear power, hydropower and water supply; and projects that meet the conditions will be encouraged to further raise the shareholding proportion of private enterprises. Private enterprises will be encouraged to increase investment in scientific and technological innovation and industrial upgrading, and application scenarios in emerging fields will be opened up to private enterprises. The lawful rights and interests of private enterprises in investment and operation will be protected in accordance with the law, and their needs for production factors such as land and financing will be met on an equal footing. The guiding and leveraging role of government investment funds will be brought into play; layout planning and the guidance and evaluation of investment direction will be strengthened; and the mechanisms for investment, financing, management and exit will be improved.
translations.b0150: Section 3  Promoting a Virtuous Cycle Between Investment and Consumption
translations.b0151: With a focus on the points where investment and consumption connect, effective investment will be used to drive up consumption capacity and willingness, consumption upgrading will be used to guide the optimization of investment direction, and the combined effect of policies to expand domestic demand will be strengthened. Industries with a strong capacity to create jobs and raise incomes will be supported in expanding investment; the construction of facilities to improve consumption infrastructure and consumption service functions will be encouraged; and investment will be increased in building consumption scenarios and upgrading facilities in fields such as health and elderly care, sports and fitness, and leisure and entertainment. Transport hubs, industrial cluster areas and other locations will be encouraged to expand consumption functions in light of local conditions. The quality and efficiency of county-level commerce will be improved, and weak links in facilities such as logistics and warehousing and rural delivery services will be strengthened.
translations.b0152: Chapter 17  Deepening the Building of a Unified National Market
translations.b0153: China will resolutely remove bottlenecks and obstacles hindering the building of a unified national market, eliminate local protectionism and market segmentation, and promote the smooth flow of goods, factors and resources on a larger scale.
translations.b0154: Section 1  Improving the Basic Systems and Rules of the Unified National Market
translations.b0155: Institution building will be advanced in areas such as property rights protection, market access, information disclosure, social credit, mergers and reorganization, and market exit, in line with the requirements of a unified national market. The property rights of all forms of ownership will be protected on an equal footing, in accordance with the law and on a long-term basis, and acts that infringe on the economic property rights and lawful interests of any form of ownership will be dealt with under equal liability and the same punishment for the same offense. The protection and application of intellectual property rights will be strengthened, and rules and guidelines for protecting trade secrets in key areas will be formulated. The market access system will be improved; the negative list for market access will be revised dynamically; and the management requirement of “one list for the whole country” will be strictly implemented. Rules and systems for information disclosure concerning enterprise quality, safety and environmental protection will be improved. The functions of the national credit information sharing platform will be strengthened; the collection and sharing of credit information and the expansion of credit applications will be advanced in depth; and mechanisms for rewarding trustworthy behavior, punishing untrustworthy behavior and repairing credit will be improved. The enterprise bankruptcy system will be improved, and a simplified exit mechanism covering all business entities will be explored. Statistical, fiscal, tax and performance evaluation systems conducive to building a unified national market will be improved; statistics based on the place where business entities’ activities occur will be promoted; and the sharing of benefits between enterprise headquarters and branches, and between places of production and places of consumption, will be optimized. Regulations on building a unified national market will be formulated.
translations.b0156: Section 2  Safeguarding a Fair Competitive Market Order
translations.b0157: Market regulation rules will be improved, benchmarks unified and capacities enhanced, so as to foster a market order in which quality is rewarded with better prices and competition is sound. Guidelines for fair competition compliance in key areas will be formulated; the rigid constraints of fair competition review will be strengthened; and barriers in areas such as access to factors, qualification recognition, bidding and tendering, and government procurement will be eliminated. Local government conduct in promoting economic development will be regulated; a list of encouraged and prohibited matters for local government investment attraction will be formulated; and information disclosure on investment attraction will be strengthened. The system for dynamically updating the list of matters that hinder the building of a unified national market and for reporting and holding relevant parties accountable will be improved. Anti-monopoly and anti-unfair competition law enforcement and judicial work will be strengthened, and anti-monopoly guidelines for key areas will be formulated. A coordinated and unified national standards system will be improved; the coverage of mandatory national standards will be expanded; standards for emerging industries will be developed; and the internationalization of standards will be raised. The sharing of inspection, testing and certification resources, mutual recognition of qualifications and mutual acceptance of results will be promoted. Market regulation and law enforcement will be unified; the system of benchmarks for administrative discretion will be improved; and two-way linkage between administrative penalties and criminal penalties will be advanced. The administrative reconsideration system and mechanisms will be improved. Comprehensive law enforcement systems and mechanisms will be improved; the tiered arrangement of regulatory matters will be optimized; and the effectiveness of law enforcement at the grassroots level will be increased.
translations.b0158: Section 3  Promoting High-Standard Connectivity of Market Facilities
translations.b0159: Circulation and logistics, market information, trading platforms and other facilities will be made more interconnected, and their rules better aligned. An efficient and smooth modern circulation system will be improved; the national logistics hub network will be refined; a number of key circulation corridors for important commodities will be built relying on strategic pivot cities for modern circulation; regions with suitable conditions will be supported in building resource allocation hubs for bulk commodities; integrated circulation rules and standards will be improved; and logistics costs across society will be reduced. Facilities and standards for multimodal transport will be strengthened and information sharing promoted; the “one document” and “one container” systems will be vigorously advanced; and rail-water intermodal transport of containers and bulk materials will be promoted. Channels for the exchange of market information will be improved, and a whole-chain mechanism for information trust and application will be developed. A unified, standard and information-sharing system of public resource trading platforms for bidding and tendering and for procurement by government departments, public institutions and state-owned enterprises will be established and improved; the application of AI and big data-based regulation will be advanced; and open management of projects throughout the entire process will be achieved.
